pages.text: Kill animals for meat, then get $(bold)Farmer's Delight$() going as early as you can. Its meals are far better than vanilla food and give long buffs.$(br2)Rice, tomatoes, cabbages and onions grow in wild patches. Grab seeds of each the first time you see them.
A $(bold)Flint Knife$() first, iron later. Knives cut ingredients on the Cutting Board and get extra drops from animals.
Place the $(bold)Cutting Board$(), put an ingredient on it, and hit it with a knife or tool.
The $(bold)Cooking Pot$() needs heat under it: a campfire, fire, or a Stove. Put ingredients in, take meals out.

The $(bold)Stove$() is a better campfire. Put a $(bold)Skillet$() on it to fry. Add-ons (Ocean's, Crabber's, My Nether's, Ender's, Twilight's Flavors, Delightful, Autochef's) add more food as you reach new places.
